label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Hey family,

I know Thanksgiving is coming up and a few of y'all have been asking Mama if I'm coming this year, so I'll just say it here: I'm coming. I'll be at Aunt Denise's in Macon on Thursday the 26th, and I'll have the mac and cheese and two sweet potato pies with me. We're eating around 3, so don't be late or the pie might not make it.

For the cousins who weren't there last year: things got heated at the table over my job. I'm not going to rehash all of it, but I do want to own my part. Somebody said something that got under my skin, and instead of letting it go I came back with a smart, disrespectful comment that I had no business saying, especially at Grandma's table on a holiday. Grandma ended up out on the porch for almost an hour, and I still feel bad about that. Grandma, I'm sorry. That day was supposed to be about family and I made it about winning an argument.

I want to be clear about one thing. I'm not sorry for the work I do. I'm proud of it and that isn't changing. What I'm sorry for is how I talked to family. Those are two different things, and I can stand on one and still apologize for the other.

I'll also save everybody some time: I can't talk about any open cases, period. That's confidentiality, not me being difficult. So if you were planning to ask me about "the lawsuit," it's a dead end. I literally can't tell you anything.

So here's what I'm asking for: a one-day truce. No work talk, no politics. Let's keep the table to food, football, the babies, and Tasha's new boyfriend (sorry Tasha, you know it's coming 😂). We can go back to disagreeing on Friday.

I love this family, even when we're loud and stubborn, and I want this to be a good day for everybody, Grandma most of all.

See y'all on the 26th. ❤️

---

A couple notes on what I did:

- **I left out the gas station TV line on purpose.** Quoting it would point everyone straight at Ray, and he'd be getting poked again in front of 40 people. "Smart, disrespectful comment" owns it without reopening it.
- **I also left out the birthday thumbs up.** Mentioning it would identify him too. If you want to acknowledge it, a quick private text to Ray before the 26th, something like "looking forward to seeing you, I'm bringing the mac and cheese," would probably mean more than anything in the group.
